decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (HA-TG-001 Rev 01, HA-TG-003 Rev 00 and Design & Access Statement Received: 29 May 2012 
Flood Risk Assessment Received: 30 May 2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The access doorway to thepremises at 48 Turnham Green Terrace shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
description: Change of use of existing use (A1 shop) to proposed use (A2 Financial & Professional services). Replacement of shop front, new fascia and hanging sign. Installation of DDA compliant access ramp
